name: manual_14ac09
claim: Before global heartbeat cleanup, stop affected workers, automatic restarts and queue mutations, and keep them quiesced until cleanup finishes; recheck the complete affected set under that maintenance window. If continuing quiescence cannot be established, do not run cleanup: the current implementation does not atomically recheck liveness before releasing each claim, so a restarting worker can lose its claim. When a peer stalls with a claimed queue task, verify the actual claimant and independently check claimed completion evidence. Only that live claimant may run queue fail <task_id> <claimant_id> --notes <reason>; it requeues only when retry_count is below max_retries, and queue claim cannot take an already claimed task. Never impersonate an absent claimant. Before global heartbeat cleanup, confirm all agents classified DEAD and obtain authorization for every affected legacy and queue claim; cleanup can requeue exhausted tasks, so hold unsafe or exhausted claims for separately reviewed authorized recovery. A reserved handoff retains required_agent_id and needs reservation-aware authorized recovery before transfer.

decisions.notes: Residual review 5848308801: prior confirmation alone cannot prevent a restart between DEAD selection and release; preserve ownership, retry and reservation safeguards and require continuing quiescence.

rationale: Residual review 5848308801: prior confirmation alone cannot prevent a restart between DEAD selection and release; preserve ownership, retry and reservation safeguards and require continuing quiescence.
